about: Fees for import, export, transit and other customs declarations.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Customs fees guide page on the checked date. Services are requested through TAMM, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 70 for an import declaration with dutiable goods
AED 80 for an import declaration with exempt goods
AED 100 for an export or temporary export declaration
